purpose: Test whether averaging several training seeds improves Task 3 under the frozen public protocol. v5 uses three seeds for Task 2 but a single seed for Task 3.
scope: Only test/03_task3_single_trial/75_task3_multiseed. src/ and src/final_config.json are read-only.

protocol.split: test/evaluate_final.py public_protocol, task3, split seed 42, RNG123 picture permutation, tune [0:256], heldout [256:768]
protocol.training: src.final.train_task with the v5 config unchanged except task3.seeds
protocol.prediction: src.final.predict_task, mean of per-seed logits, Hungarian assignment, library glyph output
protocol.metric: official OCF via src.evaluation.score_predictions on final predictions; oracle is not computed
protocol.excluded: no reranker, no candidate diagnostics, no threshold tuning

recorded_base.source: v5 fixed public anchor, reproduced by experiment 67
recorded_base.requirement: the base arm must reproduce both values within 1e-6 or this experiment is void

pass_rule.advance: heldout OCF higher than base for BOTH mice, tune OCF not lower than base minus 0.02, and at least 5 of 8 mouse x session blocks non-negative versus base
pass_rule.fallback: if seed3 fails, seed5 is descriptive only and cannot be adopted from this experiment
pass_rule.no_further_sweeps: no seed count beyond 5 may be tried in this experiment

disclosure.note: the same public heldout pictures were used in earlier experiments; this is a historical-reuse paired comparison, not a blind confirmation
